The bug was that `rd_ok` didn't check `!empty`, allowing reads to be accepted while the FIFO was empty (underflow), corrupting `rd_ptr`/`count`/`dout`. Fixed by changing `rd_ok` to `rd_en && !empty` in rtl/sync_fifo.v:20.

The design is now fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED`).
